# Age of the City

An interactive map of building footprints in the Portland, Oregon region,
colored by the recorded year built.
Buildings without a recorded year appear as unknown.
The home page includes a static map and decade table when JavaScript is disabled.

## Source and license

The City of Portland Bureau of Planning and Sustainability publishes the
[Building Footprints dataset](https://gis-pdx.opendata.arcgis.com/datasets/building-footprints).
The data is available under the
[Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License 1.0](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/pddl/1-0/).

## Map data

- [TileJSON](https://ageofthe.city/tiles/portland_buildings.json) describes the vector tiles.
- Vector tiles use `/tiles/portland_buildings/{z}/{x}/{y}.mvt` on this origin.
- Share links use `/?building={id}&year={year}&lat={lat}&lng={lng}`.
  The building ID identifies a footprint; year is its recorded year built.
  Latitude and longitude set the map location in decimal degrees.
